sim07_personnel_interaction_omnibus_full.classification_evidence: planted control on the full-data omnibus instrument detects 0.044 EPA/play at power 0.8 (raw EPA) and 0.043 (fumble-stripped EPA with xpass and wp), against a relevant 0.005 where power is 0.06; control does not prove the relevant size detectable, so no closing ground
sim07_personnel_interaction_omnibus_full.description: SIM-07 personnel x DB package interaction in EPA/play: full-data omnibus Wald test on the 10-df interaction space of 18 cells, game-cluster bootstrap null, planted control of 6 cells with random sign
sim07_personnel_interaction_omnibus_full.notes:
57 looks: 3 labels x 18 cells plus 3 omnibus; observed omnibus Q 3.3 v critical 18.0 on rank 10 (p_boot 0.97); effect is the rms interaction-cell deviation in EPA/play (0), and the units field holds mae only because the registry has no EPA unit; the omnibus is unsigned, so no probability_positive is stated; success-rate label detects 0.016 success-rate points at 0.8 (0.033 label sd, same as EPA); own family so it never pools with the signed reliability cells
[2026-11-03T15:38:29.246252+00:00] effect_units retagged: 'mae' -> 'epa_per_play'. Reason: effect is an rms interaction-cell deviation in EPA per play, not a mean absolute error
sim07_personnel_interaction_omnibus_full.plain_summary: A sharper whole-table test of personnel by package needs a 0.044 EPA per play cell shift to reach 80 percent power; the 0.005 that matters is about 77 times too small for 326k plays; no cell is resolved either way
